name: Onam Sadya at Daak 64
description:
This Onam, we invite you to experience the joy of a traditional Onam Sadya — a grand feast that brings together the many flavours of Kerala, served together on a banana leaf.

Enjoy a specially curated 30-item Sadya, featuring an abundant spread of traditional Kerala delicacies. From banana and jackfruit chips, pickles and chutneys to comforting favourites like Avial, Olan, Kalan, Thoran, Mezhukkupuratti, Pachadi and Sambar, every dish brings its own flavour to the feast. 🍛🥥

Join us at Daak 64 for a beautiful afternoon of tradition, flavour and togetherness, with a specially curated Onam Sadya.

Gather your loved ones, and celebrate the joy of Onam with us!🌸🍃

name: Founders' Content Studio
description:
Get Professional Reel, Photos and Meet Founders From Various Backgrounds

Founders know they should create more content for your business but deciding what to say, scripting, setting up the shoot and finding the time to execute - feels like too much effort

We’re taking care of all of these concerns together in one studio with the experts required to help you with all of it.

You’ll receive guidance to:

  • get 5 new professional photos shot for your Linkedin, Instagram & website.

  • Write & improve your script for the reel, and 

  • practise your delivery.

Walk in with an open mind & walk out with a professional intro reel & photos and new connections with founders.

What you’ll experience

  • A short workshop on scripting, positioning, basics of personal branding & delivery

  • Guidance on presenting confidently on camera

  • 1 introductory reel recording in a studio setup

  • 5 professionally shot photos from various list of option 

  • Conversations and networking with other business owners

  • Support from the Jigsaw Thinking team throughout the experience

What’s included

  • Scripting & Positioning workshop

  • Professional Cameras, lights

  • Professional photographer & videographer

  • One professionally recorded short-form reel

  • Edited photos & videos delivered after the event

  • Access to the complete setup

  • A curated networking experience with other founders

Who is this for?

This experience is designed for:

  • Full-time founders and entrepreneurs

  • Agency and studio owners

  • Consultants, coaches and independent professionals

  • Service-based entrepreneurs

  • Founders building a personal brand to grow their visibility and business

  • Business owners who want to create content but struggle with what to say or how to execute it

You don’t need to know how to create content. You only need a willingness to share your ideas and show up on camera. We’ll take care of the rest!

Who is this not for?

  • Part time entrepreneurs

  • Hobbyists

  • Students who are doing a part time start-up

Event details

Proposed date: Saturday, 29 August 2026
Time: 3 Pm to 7 Pm
Venue: Fosite, Indiranagar

Early Bird Passes are available now

Shoot the content you’ve been postponing & meet other business owners while you do it.

name: Manual 3.0
description:
MANUAL 3.0

What does it look like when a craft refuses to disappear?

Manual is our ongoing analog culture revival at The Commons - a space to slow down, rediscover fading crafts, and put them back into people’s hands.

Manual 3.0 is about enamel painting. Meet Surabhi, an artist from Kannur who has spent years hand-painting the bold, brush-lettered signage that once covered shopfronts, walls and banners - before flex boards took over. Think Nirma ads, toothpaste walls and playful beedi art. No stencils. No digital tools. Just muscle memory and a steady hand.

Come experience an enamel painting workshop and explore his living gallery at The Commons.

“Some crafts don't need saving. They just need a room to keep living in.”

What's the lineup?
12:00pm – Doors open with vinyl, food & drinks
12:30pm – Meet the artist
1:00pm – Explore the gallery
1:30–3:30pm – Hands-on enamel painting workshop

Come with curiosity. We’ll take care of the rest.

Ajji House by Subko, Bangalore | August 30th | 12pm onwards

Can’t make the workshop? The gallery stays live until September 5th.
